notes: Site profile: the recipe at tp4-ring on the stock 4 KiB kernel (7.0.0-1024-nvidia, no memory saver), with control traffic on the ring0 node addresses (10.10.100.x) because the nodes have no wired management network. Start it with --unqualified-shape. The GLP steering block is unset (its repository is gated). It selects a site upstream lock (config/site-upstreams.lock.json): the promoted vLLM patch head 2756478b does not reproduce here (this machine computes 2756478b for the same tree ed1bdb7a), so the site lock records the computed head.
